# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

# Load case data
with open('network.json', 'r') as f:
    case = json.load(f)

# Build pandapower network from MATPOWER case dict
net = from_mpc(case, init='flat')

# Run AC optimal power flow
pp.runopp(net, verbose=False)

# Summary calculations
total_gen_MW = net.res_gen['p_mw'].sum() if hasattr(net, 'res_gen') else 0.0
total_gen_MVAr = net.res_gen['q_mvar'].sum() if hasattr(net, 'res_gen') else 0.0

if hasattr(net, 'load'):
    total_load_MW = net.load['p_mw'].sum()
    total_load_MVAr = net.load['q_mvar'].sum()
else:
    total_load_MW = total_load_MVAr = 0.0

total_losses_MW = total_gen_MW - total_load_MW

# Total cost: pandapower stores generator cost in net.res_cost if available
if hasattr(net, 'res_cost'):
    try:
        total_cost = net.res_cost['cost'].sum()
    except Exception:
        total_cost = 0.0
else:
    total_cost = 0.0

solver_status = 'optimal' if getattr(net, 'OPF_converged', False) else getattr(net, 'OPF_status', 'failed')

# Generators list
generators = []
if hasattr(net, 'gen'):
    for idx, gen in net.gen.iterrows():
        gen_id = int(idx) + 1
        bus = int(gen['bus']) + 1  # pandapower uses zero‑based bus indices
        pg = float(net.res_gen.at[idx, 'p_mw']) if hasattr(net, 'res_gen') else 0.0
        qg = float(net.res_gen.at[idx, 'q_mvar']) if hasattr(net, 'res_gen') else 0.0
        pmin = float(gen['min_p_mw']) if 'min_p_mw' in gen else 0.0
        pmax = float(gen['max_p_mw']) if 'max_p_mw' in gen else 0.0
        qmin = float(gen['min_q_mvar']) if 'min_q_mvar' in gen else -9999.0
        qmax = float(gen['max_q_mvar']) if 'max_q_mvar' in gen else 9999.0
        generators.append({
            'id': gen_id,
            'bus': bus,
            'pg_MW': round(pg, 4),
            'qg_MVAr': round(qg, 4),
            'pmin_MW': round(pmin, 4),
            'pmax_MW': round(pmax, 4),
            'qmin_MVAr': round(qmin, 4),
            'qmax_MVAr': round(qmax, 4)
        })

# Buses list
buses = []
if hasattr(net, 'bus'):
    for idx, bus in net.bus.iterrows():
        bus_id = int(idx) + 1
        vm = float(net.res_bus.at[idx, 'vm_pu']) if hasattr(net, 'res_bus') else 0.0
        va = float(net.res_bus.at[idx, 'va_degree']) if hasattr(net, 'res_bus') else 0.0
        vmin = float(bus['min_vm_pu']) if 'min_vm_pu' in bus else 0.0
        vmax = float(bus['max_vm_pu']) if 'max_vm_pu' in bus else 0.0
        buses.append({
            'id': bus_id,
            'vm_pu': round(vm, 4),
            'va_deg': round(va, 4),
            'vmin_pu': round(vmin, 4),
            'vmax_pu': round(vmax, 4)
        })

# Branch loading (lines and transformers)
branch_records = []
if hasattr(net, 'line'):
    for idx, line in net.line.iterrows():
        loading = float(net.res_line.at[idx, 'loading_percent']) if hasattr(net, 'res_line') else 0.0
        i_ka = net.res_line.at[idx, 'i_ka'] if hasattr(net, 'res_line') else 0.0
        vn = net.bus.at[line['from_bus'], 'vn_kv']
        flow_MVA = i_ka * vn
        limit_MVA = line['max_i_ka'] * vn if 'max_i_ka' in line else 0.0
        branch_records.append({
            'from_bus': int(line['from_bus']) + 1,
            'to_bus': int(line['to_bus']) + 1,
            'loading_pct': round(loading, 4),
            'flow_from_MVA': round(flow_MVA, 4),
            'flow_to_MVA': round(flow_MVA, 4),
            'limit_MVA': round(limit_MVA, 4)
        })
if hasattr(net, 'trafo'):
    for idx, trafo in net.trafo.iterrows():
        loading = float(net.res_trafo.at[idx, 'loading_percent']) if hasattr(net, 'res_trafo') else 0.0
        i_ka = net.res_trafo.at[idx, 'i_ka'] if hasattr(net, 'res_trafo') else 0.0
        vn = net.bus.at[trafo['hv_bus'], 'vn_kv']
        flow_MVA = i_ka * vn
        limit_MVA = trafo['max_i_ka'] * vn if 'max_i_ka' in trafo else 0.0
        branch_records.append({
            'from_bus': int(trafo['hv_bus']) + 1,
            'to_bus': int(trafo['lv_bus']) + 1,
            'loading_pct': round(loading, 4),
            'flow_from_MVA': round(flow_MVA, 4),
            'flow_to_MVA': round(flow_MVA, 4),
            'limit_MVA': round(limit_MVA, 4)
        })

# Top 5 most loaded branches
most_loaded_branches = sorted(branch_records, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)[:5]

# Feasibility checks (simple tolerances)
max_p_mismatch = 0.0
max_q_mismatch = 0.0
max_voltage_violation = 0.0
max_branch_overload = 0.0
if hasattr(net, 'res_bus'):
    # power balance mismatch (generation - load - shunt) vs. calculated injection
    mism_p = (net.res_bus['p_mw'] - net.bus['p_mw']).abs().max() if 'p_mw' in net.bus else 0.0
    mism_q = (net.res_bus['q_mvar'] - net.bus['q_mvar']).abs().max() if 'q_mvar' in net.bus else 0.0
    max_p_mismatch = float(mism_p)
    max_q_mismatch = float(mism_q)
    # voltage limits violation
    if 'max_vm_pu' in net.bus:
        over = (net.res_bus['vm_pu'] - net.bus['max_vm_pu']).clip(lower=0).max()
        max_voltage_violation = max(float(over), max_voltage_violation)
    if 'min_vm_pu' in net.bus:
        under = (net.bus['min_vm_pu'] - net.res_bus['vm_pu']).clip(lower=0).max()
        max_voltage_violation = max(float(under), max_voltage_violation)
if branch_records:
    max_branch_overload = max([b['loading_pct'] for b in branch_records]) - 100.0
    max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, 0.0)

report = {
    "summary": {
        "total_cost_per_hour": round(total_cost, 2),
        "total_load_MW": round(total_load_MW, 2),
        "total_load_MVAr": round(total_load_MVAr, 2),
        "total_generation_MW": round(total_gen_MW, 2),
        "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_gen_MVAr, 2),
        "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses_MW, 2),
        "solver_status": solver_status
    },
    "generators": generators,
    "buses": buses,
    "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded_branches,
    "feasibility_check": {
        "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
        "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
        "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_voltage_violation, 6),
        "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_branch_overload, 6)
    }
}

with open('report.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

print('Report written to report.json')
